intro: The contract you recovered bears the name of Baron Vardus, a nobleman from the old kingdom of Alterac. Magistrate Henry Maleb in Southshore wants him found and brought to justice, and asks for the baron's head.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The contract you recovered was signed by Baron Vardus, a noble of the former kingdom of Alterac, and one known for a cold heart and brutal practices. I'm not surprised someone like the Baron was behind this.
Find this man. Find him, and bring him to justice. He must be among the Syndicate haunts - perhaps at the ruins of Strahnbrad, or perhaps within the valley north of them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Baron Vardus cannot think Southshore will allow him to send his thugs against us with impunity. I want his head!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. My head rests a little easier, knowing that villain lost his.
